name: Qatar Foundation
note: BAL partner (bal.nba.com/partners). Not-for-profit founded by the late Father Amir Sheikh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser (qf.org.qa/about); state-royal link recorded as a note, no ownerId assigned. Update 2026-10-03: QF was among the record 22 marketing, merchandising and institutional partners supporting the BAL in the 2026 season (pr.nba.com/2026-basketball-africa-league-season-numbers, opened 2026-10-03), and its logo appears on the upper back of BAL 2026 uniforms, visible in the BAL's official game photo of JCA Kings (cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/05/JCA-Kings-vs-ASC-Ville-Dakar-5-scaled.jpg, opened 2026-10-03). QF's own About page says the late Father Amir of Qatar and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser shared a vision which 'led to the creation of Qatar Foundation' (qf.org.qa/about, opened 2026-10-03); no opened source states who owns or controls QF today, so the sponsor stays unrated.
